publisher: Oath & Action’s systems atlas, Who Do They Answer To?
title_or_table: Reconciliation of earlier atlas drawings to the model: Phase 0’s 45 rows and the rows added in Phase 3
table_id: Phase 0 reconciliation table rows 1 to 45; V7.1 issue list items; nodes, links, loops, reforms, routes, issues, claims, glossary and methods
observation_period: Model snapshot of October 15, 2026; earlier pages as Phase 0 read them on October 20, 2026, rerun November 13, 2026
universe_or_base: Phase 0’s 45 rows of conflicts and ambiguities and 12 rows for what Phase 2 and Phase 3 drew from the model
unit: rows; each model value is text read from the model
qualification: No earlier drawing is evidence for a model value: the value_shown column records what a page showed, and every model_value is read from the model. On November 13, 2026 all 2,644 of Phase 0’s comparisons were rerun from Dustin’s three uploads: 2,642 match and 2 conflict, both in row 42 (the Ledger’s reform counts for D03 and D04, which count the rejected R-35); Phase 0’s 45 rows are 9 identifier, 1 sign, 1 grade, 1 delay, 12 label, 7 structure and 14 encoding; 8 flags were read in context and set aside. Rows 11, 17, 47, 48 and 52 rest partly on V7’s renderer, which is not in this container; their renderer facts are Phase 0’s and the V7.1 list’s readings. Row 40’s model value differs from Phase 0’s note: the model’s evidence summary for Loop B4 names L54 the weakest step for U.S. services. Chapter and rule numbers are those of November 14, 2026; chapter 11’s numbers move under DR-274 and no row cites chapter 11.

row.description: Row ID: Phase 0’s number for rows 1 to 45; 46 on for rows added in round 5

print_order.description: The order the plate prints, by the data lead’s ruling (e)

group.description: What a copied drawing could mislead a reader about: a value, a sign, a grade, a delay, identifiers, structure, encoding, labels, or drawn in Phase 2 and Phase 3

origin.description: Where the row comes from: Phase 0’s table, or the V7.1 issue list item it ties to

phase0_type.description: Phase 0’s type: ID, sign, grade, delay, label, structure or encoding; empty for new rows

pages.description: The earlier pages that show the item: V5 Polished, the Atlas Visual System, Concepts V2; Atlas V7 for new rows

location.description: Where on those pages, as Phase 0 wrote it; for new rows, the model fields

item.description: The item, as Phase 0 named it; for new rows, the subject and the issue

value_shown.description: What the earlier page shows, as Phase 0 recorded it; never evidence for a model value

phase0_v7_value.description: The model value as Phase 0 wrote it on October 20, 2026, kept for the record

model_value.description: The model’s value read today by script from the snapshot of October 15, 2026; quotes keep the atlas’s straight apostrophes

resolution_in_guide.description: The resolution as the guide applies it today

guide_rules.description: The rules that apply it, joined with semicolons; none where no rule needs to

status.description: applied; not printed (no chapter or specimen in work/build/guide/ shows the item); open or due in round 5; or proposed for board 3

value_conflict.description: True for row 42, which holds Phase 0’s two value conflicts, D03 and D04
